entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, isn't that a town off in the distance?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, I can see what appear to be buildings[n]over there.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Do you think that's the town Futaba[n]mentioned over there?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Huh? There's nothing left for us to do[n]in the town... Are you sure you want to[n]go back there?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What is that in the distance? I can see[n]buildings...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I think I saw that on our way here too—[n]though it was so hot, my memory's a[n]little hazy...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Want to head over to the town, Joker?[n]It's pretty far away, so this is my chance[n]to shine!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Okay. Just let me know when you're[n]feeling ready to go!
